name: Houjou Sai
source: Muko Misora's mentor and the previous head of the Houjou Cabal of Devil Hunters.  She is a ruthless, hedonistic woman whose 'change' has stopped her outward aging.  She loves her students but is perfectly willing to allow them to destroy themselves (and will frequently tip them over the edge as a test).
